entry.name: live.text
entry.description: live.text object is a user interface object used to create buttons and toggles.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Toggles the object's active mode. Whenis set to 0, the mouse action does not cause output and the inactive colors are used.

attributes.name: activebgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color off displayed when theattribute is set to 1.

attributes.name: activebgoncolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color on displayed when theattribute is set to 1.

attributes.name: activetextcolor
attributes.description: Sets the display color for theobject's text in RGBA format.

attributes.name: activetextoncolor
attributes.description: Sets the display color for theobject's text when it is on.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: annotation_name
attributes.description: The string that is prepended to annotations. This shows up in the Info pane in Live, and the clue window in Max.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: Defines the display style. The options are:0: Default. The text appears with the boundaries of the text box.1: Label. The text box appears as a square button, with the text appearing to the right.2: LCD. The text appears with the boundaries of the text box.

attributes.name: automation
attributes.description: Sets the automation "off" label that will appear in Live.

attributes.name: automationon
attributes.description: Sets the automation on label that will appear in Live.

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: bgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color "off" displayed when theattribute is set to 0.

attributes.name: bgoncolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color on displayed when theattribute is set to 0.

attributes.name: bordercolor
attributes.description: Sets the display color for theobject's border in RGBA format.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: focusbordercolor
attributes.description: Sets the display color for theobject's border in RGBA format.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: inactivelcdcolor
attributes.description: Sets the display color in the RGBA format for theobject in LCD mode when theattribute is set to 0. In the off state this sets the text color, while in the on state it sets the background color.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: labeltextcolor
attributes.description: Sets the display color for theobject's text when it is in the label display mode.

attributes.name: lcdbgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the display color in the RGBA format for theobject in LCD mode. In the off state this sets the background color, while in the on state it sets the text color.

attributes.name: lcdcolor
attributes.description: Sets the display color in the RGBA format for theobject in LCD mode when theattribute is set to 1. In the off state this sets the text color, while in the on state it sets the background color.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Sets the button mode. Button modes are:0: Button mode1: Toggle (switch) mode

attributes.name: outputmode
attributes.description: Sets the output mode for theobject when it'sattribute is set to 1 (toggle). Whenis set to 0, output occurs on mousedown, when set to 1, output occurs on mouseup.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

attributes.name: parameter_mappable
attributes.description: When parameter_mappable is enabled, the object will be available for mapping to keyboard or MIDI input using the.

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: pictures
attributes.description: Sets the paths for pictures used when theattribute is set to 1. Bitmap images such as PNG or vectorized images (SVG) can be used.

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: remapsvgcolors
attributes.description: Sets the SVG image colors to use when drawing the image. Ifis set to 0, the colors supplied by the SVG file are used; if set to 1, the color attributes for the appropriate display mode are used.

attributes.name: rounded
attributes.description: Set the roundness of the border

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Sets the button label when the button is in the off state.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.description: Sets the display color for theobject's text when theattribute is set to 0.

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textoffcolor
attributes.description: Sets the display color for theobject's text when it is in the off state and theattribute is set to 0.

attributes.name: texton
attributes.description: Sets the button label when the button is in the "on" state.

attributes.name: transition
attributes.description: The parameter automation ofstores 0 and 1 values. Theattribute specifies when awill be sent to the outlet.

attributes.name: usepicture
attributes.description: Toggles the use of pictures instead of text for display. Note that you need to provide enough pictures by setting theattribute properly.

attributes.name: usesvgviewbox
attributes.description: Sets the viewbox for the svg files whenis set to 1. Ifis set to 0, Max determines the viewbox; if set to 1, uses the viewbox flag supplied by the svg file.

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Highlight the text, send the text and a bang
messages.description: Inmode, a mouse click onhighlights it for as long as the mouse is held down, sending the text out the second outlet and amessage out the left outlet.Inmode, a mouse click behaves the same as a. When the mouse is clicked, theobject will send a 1 out the left outlet if the cursor is inside of theobject's rectangle, and a 0 if it is not. The button text is also sent out the second outlet on mouse click.

messages.name: assign
messages.description: The word, followed by a floating point value, causes that value to be displayed and sent out theobject's outlet. The value, however, will not be stored. If the Parameter Visibility attribute is set to Stored Only, themessage will not add the new value to the Live application’s undo chain.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: A bang message will toggle the state of the object.
messages.description: A bang message will toggle the state of the object. If it is off, it will switch on and output a 1. If it is on, it will switch off and output a 0.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Toggle the button, send its text and a 0/1 message

messages.name: init
messages.digest: Restore and output the initial value
messages.description: Restore and output the initial value.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Toggle the button, send its text and a 0/1 message
messages.description: In themode, any non-zero number will toggle the button to the "on" position, send the button text out the middle outlet and send a 1 out the left outlet. A zero sets the toggle to the "off" position, sends the button text out the middle outlet and sends a 0 out the left outlet.

messages.name: outputvalue
messages.digest: Send the current value out the outlet
messages.description: Sends the current value out the outlet.

messages.name: rawfloat
messages.description: A raw normalized value (between 0. and 1.) received in the inlet is converted to a real value, and then functions like any other received int value in toggle mode.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Toggle the state without sending output
messages.description: In themode, themessages toggles the "on" or "off" state without sending anything out the outlets. The word, followed by any non-zero number, sets toggle to on. The messagesets it to "off".

messages.name: setsymbol
messages.digest: Choose a button by name and toggle it without causing output
messages.description: In themode, the word, followed by a symbol that specifies a button text item, causesto display that symbol and act as though the object were toggled to that state.

messages.name: symbol
messages.digest: Choose a button by name and toggle it
messages.description: In themode, the word, followed by a symbol that specifies a button text item, causesto display that symbol and sends the current values out the outlets.
